specification.objective: Address only the technically valid request-changes findings from pull request #34 while preserving existing project/task behavior and API compatibility.

requirements.statement: Changing the selected project must clear task state and task errors before the first listener notification for the new project.
The active project management list must never retain or add projects whose returned status is inactive, and selection must move when the selected project becomes inactive.
A task creation response must not mutate task state if the user selected another project while the request was pending.
Project description must remain nullable as on main; omitted or explicit null descriptions are accepted and round-trip as null, while non-null blank text remains invalid.
The locked POLIS Change Contract for these PR #34 review fixes must be versioned under docs/contracts/pr34-review-request-changes-v1.polis.json.

acceptance_criteria.statement: selectProject clears tasks and tasksError before notifyListeners.
createProject excludes inactive results and updateProject removes an inactive result while reselecting when necessary.
createTask checks that selectedProjectId still matches the captured project before mutating tasks or selectedTaskId.
POST and PUT project payloads with description null succeed and return description null.
The locked schema-v4 Change Contract is present and parseable at the declared repository path.

invariants.statement: Project soft deletion remains status=inactive rather than physical deletion.
Existing task authorization, hierarchy, membership and capacity semantics remain unchanged.
Only active projects are presented by the project management controller after synchronization.

forbidden_states.statement: The UI can notify a new selected project while still exposing tasks from the previous project.
An inactive project remains in or is inserted into the controller active list.
A late createTask response for project A mutates state after project B has become selected.
A payload accepted by main with description null now fails validation or is coerced to an empty string.

inputs.statement: Project selection changes and asynchronous project/task API responses.
Project create/update payloads with active or inactive status and nullable description.

outputs.statement: Consistent project/task controller state across project changes and delayed responses.
A versioned POLIS contract recording the accepted review fixes.

failure_semantics.statement: Stale asynchronous results are ignored rather than applied to a newer selection.
Non-null blank descriptions still fail request validation.
Flutter tests are not claimed as executed when Flutter is unavailable locally.
